name: ai-testing-marketplace
description: Agentic testing from your editor: run playbooks (Jira → test cases → Playwright/k6/security/coverage → CI → PR), watch results, overlay Go coverage, and give Copilot/Cursor agent mode the marketplace as tools via MCP.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Connect to an AI Testing Marketplace backend to see playbooks.
[Start local backend](command:atm.startBackend)
[Configure backend URL](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22aiTestingMarketplace.backendUrl%22)
[Open setup guide](command:atm.setupGuide)
[Set API token](command:atm.setApiToken)

commands.title: ATM: Register MCP server for Copilot / Cursor agent mode

aiTestingMarketplace.backendUrl.description: URL of the AI Testing Marketplace backend (local `python -m web.server`, or your team's hosted instance).

aiTestingMarketplace.platformPath.description: Path to the agentic-testing-pipeline checkout — used to start the local backend, launch the MCP server, and find generated/coverage/coverage.lcov. Defaults to the workspace folder.

aiTestingMarketplace.pythonPath.description: Python used to run the backend and MCP server (e.g. .venv/bin/python).

walkthroughs.title: Get started with AI Testing Marketplace
walkthroughs.description: Connect the extension to a backend, run your first playbook, and give your coding agent the marketplace as tools.

steps.title: Connect a backend
steps.description:
The extension is a client of the AI Testing Marketplace platform. Run it locally or point to your team's hosted instance.
[Start local backend](command:atm.startBackend)
[Configure URL](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22aiTestingMarketplace.backendUrl%22)
Then create an API token in the dashboard (Configuration → API tokens) and store it here:
[Set API token](command:atm.setApiToken)

steps.title: Run your first playbook
steps.description:
Pick a saved Configuration (Jira + app + repo + Jenkins) and a Jira ticket — the agents derive cases, generate grounded automation, self-heal, run CI and open a PR.
[Run Playbook…](command:atm.runPlaybook)

steps.title: Give your coding agent the marketplace
steps.description:
Register the MCP server so Copilot agent mode, Cursor or Claude Code can start runs and read results as tools.
[Register MCP server](command:atm.registerMcp)
